answer: Each identity must build a delta, a river delta of many small streams of real work. Honest deltas branch into many channels; a farm's are one straight canal. Every identity keeps a vault, a locked store of its past deeds. Honest vaults hold many treasures; a farm's hold one coin, stamped one hour. Trust is ferrous iron, rusting when neglected, hardening when worked. Honest iron is forged daily; a farm's is painted to look forged, but it rusts the same way everywhere. To pass, a farm must build a real delta, fill a real vault, and forge real ferrous iron for every sockpuppet.
